data.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Coinbase
data.about: "Talk is cheap, show me the code."

description.text:
The Transfers system powers billion of dollars of fund movements every month across multiple Coinbase products. Our services provide reliable, scalable, consistent, and auditable fund flow orchestration for hundreds of internal developers to quickly deliver and iterate innovative crypto applications. 

- Led a group of 5 engineers to decompose the tier-0 crypto buys/sells/trades flow out of the monolith system and shorten the trade processing time by 70%. 
- Reduced the monolith transfer orchestration share from 60+% to 10%, resulting in over $200k yearly saving. 
- Established the fund flow blueprint for international expansions which supported Coinbase to launch in Brazil, Japan, Australia, and the UK. 
- Initiated and oversaw the Transfer scaling project which 4x-ed the service's capacity and enabled multiple high-throughput funds flows to launch. 
- Mentored 10+ engineers across projects by striking a balance between project execution and engineer development.

Smart Pie develops interactive Math education apps for children aged 3 to 8 in China. The company grew from 4 to 150 employees, and received 3 rounds of million dollars investments.
- Managed the development department of 50 people, including engineers, PMs, and designers.
- Led over 100 product releases with the user base grew from 0 to 225k.
- Built scalable frontend and backend architecture that supports 1M+ learning sessions every month.
- Developed realtime data analysis system that processes 400k+ data entries every day.
- Created intuitive no-code courseware editor which speeded product development by 50%.
- Deployed CI/CD pipelines that supports fully automated frontend, backend and app releasing. 
- Adopted Agile for iterative development and OKR to track objectives.

Technologies: React, Node.js, Cocos Creator, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, Flink, GraphQL, Alicloud

- Increased test coverage for the Benefits product line by 50%. 
- Delivered technical trainings regarding new React + GraphQL tech stack to the development teams. 
- Designed role-based authorization & authentication system for micro services. 

Technologies: React, React Native, Ember.js, Django, Python, MySQL, GraphQL

- Received the annual CTO Appreciation Award for outstanding contribution.

Outstanding Creation of Genesys Designer - Engineering Days 2015

Greg Wang is a CX Champion for living the value, “Create Customer Success”. 

Here is what, Slava Sayko had to say,
I'd like to nominate whole Designer team for Diamond award. The team is nominated for Diamond award for their outstanding achievement of creating new product - Genesys Designer - in record time. Genesys Designer is a product that enabled efficient, fast and simple creation and management of Call Flows on Genesys Cloud. This team created a product that allows customers creating Call Flows which utilize all power of Genesys GVP and Routing platforms in a simple and user friendly way, hiding underlying complexity and at the same time providing intuitive user experience. Thanks to this team and Designer they created we were able to win and keep multiple Cloud customers by efficiently delivering capabilities customers need and providing great level of self-service.
Thank you ! Slava.”

The compiler was implemented in Java. It follows the modern compiler structure, which includes DFA Scanner, LR1 Parser, AST Constructor, Symbol Table Generator, Type Checker, Static Analyzer and Code Generator. 

Techniques Applied: 
- Visitor Pattern, integrated in the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) data structure, is widely used for tree traversing.
- A HashMap based Symbol Table offers two-way direct access between an AST Node and a Symbol (i.e., method names). 
- JUnit test, automatically tests the compiler against hundreds testcases.
